description: CMS content tools for the AI connector (ADR-0004): list_pages, get_page, list_block_types, create_page, update_page, upload_image, list_revisions and restore_revision, each a ConnectorTool that calls the Application commands and queries of laravel/cms (SavePageCommand and RestorePageRevisionCommand with revision source ai, the block catalogue and BlockValidator) and asks the gates view-cms-pages and edit-cms-pages, which default to the admin gate use-ai-connector. A page created by an assistant is always unpublished; an assistant cannot publish, delete, change the home page, a published slug, settings, users or form submissions. upload_image takes base64 content, checks the type, size and real image bytes like the admin upload and stores the file on the cms-media disk. The layer adds CmsAiServiceProvider (registers the tools through the config key ai-connector.tools) and overwrites bootstrap/providers.php (the last layer owns the list) and the client guide docs/client/ai-connector.md (Czech, with the CMS can and cannot table). Needs laravel/ai-connector and laravel/cms, so it comes after both.
